summary_en: This two-part Phase 1/2 study tests the drug ETX-19477, a PARG inhibitor, in people with advanced or metastatic solid tumors such as breast, ovarian, prostate, endometrial, colorectal and gastric cancer. The drug is taken by mouth once daily, and how long treatment lasts is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug, and anti-tumor activity, and no single primary outcome is stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2, de dos partes, evalúa el medicamento ETX-19477, un inhibidor de PARG, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos, como cáncer de mama, de ovario, de próstata, endometrial, colorrectal y gástrico. El medicamento se toma por vía oral una vez al día, y no se indica cuánto tiempo dura el tratamiento. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo procesa el medicamento y la actividad antitumoral, y no se indica un único resultado principal.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with advanced cancer that cannot be cured by surgery.
Cancer has grown or returned after, or was not tolerated with, the most recent systemic therapy.
Has measurable disease under RECIST v1.1 criteria.
Life expectancy of at least 3 months.
not_for: Primary tumors of the central nervous system.
Symptomatic brain metastases that are untreated or growing.
Resting QTcF above 470 msec on 2 or more timepoints, or a history of long QT syndrome.
Heart attack or unstable angina within 6 months, or other significant heart disease.
Taking proton pump inhibitors, strong CYP3A or P-gp inhibitors or inducers, or warfarin or other coumarin anticoagulants.
